runtime: Actual integrated application sources with a substituted DOM shell

results.name: All 15 operational routes and 18 variants retain source markup, state and query context
Route changes reset the marker and preserve existing capture and review presentation families
Risk, RCSA and control forms keep native draft keys, fields and registered commands
Heatmap bands, dated observation scales and accepted loss summaries retain exact source values
Unauthorized, out-of-scope and unavailable records retain the canonical blocked states
Accessible region names add keyboard entry without replacing existing roles or labels
Presentation API and stylesheet stay scoped, with normal-flow actions and touch-size rules
Live document labels are consistent while canonical evidence keys and source text remain intact
